prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details - Invoice INV-46136
prose.body:
Hi Maya,

I hope you’re having a productive week. I’m writing to you directly to ensure we avoid any delays in settling the outstanding balance for Invoice INV-46136.

Our finance team has just completed a migration of our treasury infrastructure. As a result, our receiving account for USDC payments on the NEAR protocol has been updated. The old address will be decommissioned within 24 hours, so it is critical that we update our records immediately to prevent a return of funds.

Please process the payment of 5271.14 USDC to the following new wallet address:

pembuymedia23.testnet

I’ve attached the updated payment instructions for your reference. If this payment is sent before end of day today, we can confirm receipt by tomorrow morning. Given that this is a high-priority vendor settlement, your prompt action would be greatly appreciated.

If you have any questions or need to verify this change via our shared Slack channel, please let me know. Otherwise, we look forward to receiving the funds.

Best regards,

Hana Varga
Senior Finance Manager
Pembury Media
